title: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct FP8 on vLLM: single 24GB card
slug_note: Image and video understanding on one 24GB card: 10.6GB FP8 weights with room for multimodal KV.

variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-FP8 resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-25 test

engine.config: Stock vLLM multimodal serve; cap context because image/video tokens inflate KV quickly

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-25): 112.9 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (vLLM default --gpu-memory-utilization (0.9), so this is the reservation, not the model's minimum need). That is vLLM's 0.9 reservation of the shared pool, not the model's minimum need. Earlier estimate: 10.6GB weights + vision activations + KV; hours-long video at the 1M-context end is not a 24GB-card workload.

measurements.method: openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (626-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

caveats: Size computed from the HF API.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-25), in vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0 with the HF cache mounted: server ready 280 s after `docker run` (weights from local disk, kernel autotune included); the functional check passed. 112.9 GiB dropped from MemAvailable is vLLM's default 0.9 reservation of the 128 GB pool, not the model's minimum need.
